testcase.name: Scenario: Close a newly created empty active part: tmp/obk-quick-access-3955-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:83:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Close a newly created empty active part ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And other documents are also open ✔ When the user creates a new empty part from a standard metric template ✔ Then the new part becomes active and has its own document tab ✔ When the user clicks the close button on the new part's tab without editing it ✔ Then the new part's tab disappears without a save prompt ✔ And the previously active part is displayed again ✔ And its model browser and viewport are restored
